patch_description: The local block-MAD Q currently only affects the refinement pass; the first (noisy-input) pass still uses the global Q, so busy segments (5 Hz component) are over-smoothed before the adaptive pass can recover them — contributing to lag_error (0.34) and avg_error (0.39). I propose (1) computing the local block-MAD qseq on the rough moving-average trajectory before the first pass and blending it into the first-pass process noise (Q[k] = max(local, global)·Qbase), so busy segments get responsive tracking from the start; and (2) tightening the refinement pass scale from 0.25 to 0.15 to recover noise_reduction (which slipped to 0.55) since the first pass now carries the adaptivity. Block medians over the MA-smoothed input remain robust to transients, unlike recursive EWMA estimates.
